Definition: Uthai, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Uthai the son of Ammihud stands among the first dwellers in Jerusalem after the return. Uthai of the sons of Bigvai came up with Ezra, with seventy males.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Uthais show the return in miniature: one settles Jerusalem and the other travels up with Ezra, and both are counted because coming home took names, not just numbers.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
